source.anchor: SPHMC arXiv2609.06906v1 S3.SS1.p1.1 eta>0, S2.E1/S3.E2/S4.Ex3 proximal and Gaussian evaluator, S4.E4/E5, Ex8/p4.1/p4.2/p4.3/E6 only lastTWO comparisons. NeighborLemma4.1 eta<=1 excluded; numericaleta<=1/(2beta) cost separate.
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu, Matthew S. Zhang; exact proximal/evaluator and only Lemma4.2 input/noise components.

items.statement: Produce a measurable exact proximal selector p satisfying p+eta*gradientV(p)=y, the genuine quantitative quadratic minimum and uniqueness, and fixed-eta nonexpansivity. The literal Gaussian gradient evaluator G(s,z)=gradientV(p(s)+sqrt(eta(s))*z) is jointly measurable and obeys input/noise Lipschitz constants 1 and sqrteta for equal eta. Produce an actual Markov kernel K(s)=stdGaussian.map(G(s,-)). This covers the exact evaluator (3.2) and only Lemma4.2 (4.4)-(4.5), with no posterior or finite-query claim.
assumptions: Source beta=1, alpha=kappa^-1, real kappa>=1; actual C2 V with kappa^-1*normv^2 <= D2V(x)[v,v] <= normv^2 for every x,v.

Finite real complete Hilbert/Borel full space E, including dimension zero; arbitrary measurable parameter space S; actual measurable eta:S->R and y:S->E with eta(s)>0 for every s. These coordinate-free/parameter-space extensions are disclosed. Printed Lemma4.2 inherits eta>0 from Section3.1; the eta<=1 premise of neighboring Lemma4.1 is not consumed.

No supplied proximal point, minimizer, measurable selector, gradient estimate, Lipschitz bound or Markov kernel. All are produced from the literal potential and actual Gaussian pushforward. The source numerical-prox call cap eta<=1/(2beta) remains a separate computational contract.

formulae.label: Actual full-range proximal Gaussian oracle
formulae.tex: F_s(x)=V(x)+\|x-y_s\|^2/(2\eta_s),\quad p_s+\eta_s\nabla V(p_s)=y_s,\quad G(s,z)=\nabla V(p_s+\sqrt{\eta_s}z),\quad K_s=G(s,\cdot)_\#\gamma.
